[[Raja Beni Mellal|R Beni Mellal]] |matches= 240 |total goals= 524 |prevseason= [[2018–19 Botola|2018–19]] |nextseason= [[2020–21 Botola|2020–21]] |updated = 11 October 2020 }} The '''2019–20 Botola''', is the 63rd season of the Premier League and the 9th under its new format of Moroccan Pro League, [[Botola|the top Moroccan professional league]] for [[association football]] clubs, since its establishment in 1956.{{Cite web|url=https://www.frmf.ma/fr/content/histoire-du-football-au-maroc|title=Histoire du Football au Maroc {{!}} الموقع الرسمي للجامعة الملكية المغربية لكرة القدم|website=www.frmf.ma|access-date=2019-08-22}} [[Wydad Casablanca]] came into the season as defending champions of the [[2018–19 Botola|2018–19 season]]. [[Nahdat Zemamra]] and [[Raja Beni Mellal]] entered as the two promoted teams from the [[2018–19 Botola 2]]. The season started on 14 September 2019, and was scheduled to end on 1 July 2020.{{Cite web|url=http://botola.snrt.ma/resultats|title=Botola - Société Nationale de Radiodiffusion et de Télévision|website=Botola - Société Nationale de Radiodiffusion et de Télévision|language=en|access-date=2019-08-22}} However, the season was suspended in March 2020, due to [[COVID-19 pandemic in Morocco]], then resumed in July and ended in 11 October 2020.{{cite web |url=https://www.cafonline.com/news-center/news/morocco-s-botola-resumed-after-four-months-of-stoppage |title=Morocco's "Botola"
